widget_help: Freely arrangeable, animated energy flow diagram. Open the designer to place producers, consumers and storage.
widget_not_configured: No diagram yet. Open the designer in the widget settings.
name: Title
attr_none_stored: There are no stored diagrams yet. Create one in the admin tab "Energy flow", or store the one of this widget centrally.
attr_missing: The diagram "%s" this widget refers to no longer exists.
attr_admin_hint: Also editable in the admin tab "Energy flow". A change reaches every widget that shows this diagram.
tab_rename_hint: Only the display name changes; widgets that refer to the diagram keep working.
tab_delete_confirm: Delete "%s"? Widgets that show it will be empty afterwards.
tab_unsaved_text: The changes to "%s" have not been saved. Discard them?
tab_empty_hint: A diagram stored here can be shown by any vis-2 widget and any card in the device manager, and edited here without opening vis. Every widget that shows it follows a change the moment it is saved.
editor_resize_hint: Drag to change the width, double-click to reset it
json_unknown_format: This is neither an energy flow diagram, a set of diagrams, nor an energiefluss-erweitert configuration.
json_bundle_empty: This is a set of diagrams, but none of them could be read.
json_bundle_many: This file contains %s diagrams, and only one fits here. "Import diagrams" in the admin tab "Energy flow" turns each of them into a diagram of its own.
tab_export_unsaved: Exported the saved version; the unsaved changes are not included.
tab_import_intro: Each of these becomes a new diagram. Existing diagrams are not changed.
tab_import_nothing: None of the files contains a diagram.
mode_signed_hint: A positive value flows from the first to the second node, a negative one the other way. The usual case for a grid meter or a battery.
mode_positive_hint: Only from the first to the second node; a negative value counts as zero.
mode_split_hint: One state per direction. The diagram shows the difference between them.
src_same_hint: The number the node shows as its value, converted below if needed.
src_factor_tooltip: The raw value is multiplied by this. 0.001 turns W into kW.
src_deadband_tooltip: Values below this amount count as zero. Against sensor noise.
src_invert_tooltip: For meters that report the import as a negative value.
src_formula_hint: e.g. a + b, a - b, sum(a, b, c), if(a > 95, 0, b). Operators + - * / and the functions abs, min, max, clamp, round, sum, avg, if.
icon_custom_hint: Anything the browser can display, e.g. a path under /files/ or a base64 data URI.
json_ef_stats: %s elements, %s connections. %s texts and icons were folded into the elements, %s state ids carried over.
json_ef_warn_icon_unmapped: Icon "%s" has no counterpart; the default icon of the type is used.
json_ef_warn_unit_blanked: The original hides the unit "%s" for this value; here the unit of the state is shown.
json_ef_warn_display_mode: Shows "%s" instead of the value; only the value is imported.
json_ef_warn_action_dropped: The click action "%s" is not imported.
json_ef_warn_orphan_value: A value was not inside any box; it became a small element of its own.
json_ef_warn_edge_dropped: The connection "%s" does not join two existing elements and was left out.
json_ef_warn_css_dropped: Custom CSS of an element has no equivalent and was left out.
json_ef_nothing: This is an energiefluss-erweitert configuration, but it contains no element that could be converted.
json_hint: Paste a diagram here to replace the current one, or copy this one to a second widget.
json_not_an_object: The text is valid JSON, but not a diagram object.
json_no_valid_nodes: No usable element: every node needs an "id".
insp_id_taken: This ID is already in use.
insp_unit_hint: W is scaled to kW / MW automatically.
insp_hide_when_zero: Hide while the value is zero
insp_threshold_hint: Below this amount the line is muted and does not animate.
insp_show_value: Show the value on the line
insp_color_hint: Without a colour, a connection takes the colour of wherever the energy comes from.
insp_canvas_hint: The diagram is scaled into the widget, so these are proportions rather than pixels.
insp_anim_ref_power_hint: The value at which the dots move at normal speed. Twice as much is twice as fast.
insp_label_scale_hint: Relative to the label size of the diagram (%s)
insp_label_size_hint: Labels below the nodes and values on the connections. Empty: three quarters of the font size.
insp_shortcuts_hint: Drag a frame over the canvas or %s/Shift+click to select several nodes. Arrow keys move them, Shift+arrow keys resize them. %s+C copies, %s+V pastes, Del deletes.
insp_bend_hint: Where both ends leave in the same direction, the middle piece of the line can be dragged on the canvas. A double click puts it back in the middle.
insp_reset_bend: Middle piece back to the middle
insp_level_max_hint: Fills the node in proportion, e.g. 1400 for a 1400 W array. In %s; empty: no fill.
insp_level_max_from_state: Empty: the maximum of the state object; 0: no fill
insp_history_no_adapter: No default history adapter is set (system settings, "Default history").
insp_history_state_only: Only for a value that is a single state.
insp_history_not_recorded: This state is not recorded by %s. Enable it in the settings of the object.
insp_kpi_hint: Computed from the producers, the grid and the storage of the diagram; the value source is not used.
insp_energy_today_hint: Integrated since midnight by the history adapter; the state must be recorded.
insp_stale_after_hint: Dimmed when the state was not updated for this long.
insp_stale_after_default_hint: Nodes whose state was not updated for this long are dimmed. Empty: never.
insp_rules_hint: The first rule that matches wins -- put the most specific first.
insp_color_scale_hint: E.g. the electricity price: green when cheap, red when expensive. The lines take the colour too.
insp_action_chart_hint: Opens the history of the state, from the default history adapter.
history_no_data: No recorded values in this period.
wizard_title: Build a diagram from your devices
wizard_scanning: Looking for states that report power…
wizard_intro: %s states report power. Ticked ones were recognised by their name -- check the kind, untick what does not belong.
wizard_more: %s more -- narrow the filter to see them.
wizard_soc: State of charge of the battery
wizard_sign_hint: Grid and battery are read as: positive = drawn from it / discharged. If a meter counts the other way, use "Invert sign" on the connection afterwards.
insp_style_hint: How boxes and lines look. Every style follows the light or dark theme of the system.
preset_replace_warning: The current diagram will be replaced.
preset_pv_battery_home_desc: The classic. Needs three states: PV power, grid power and battery power.
preset_pv_home_desc: Without a battery. Needs two states.
preset_pv_battery_wallbox_desc: House and wallbox behind a junction.
preset_pv_battery_heating_desc: House and heat pump behind a junction.
